_note: What Sayo says when the farmer talks to them (Talk, README.md, Villagers): the first pick whose if holds names the lines, one of them by the day; the gift_ lines answer a gift by its reaction (gift_birthday on their birthday); gift_items names their own answer to a keepsake or a dish (Talk.gift_line), by item or by dish: / keepsake:<reaction> (gifts in data/villagers/sayo.json). Our own lines.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: You remembered? It's silly, but nobody says it at the counter. Thank you.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: On my birthday too... I'll put it by the window so I see it every morning.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Did you forget something? Take your time.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Ah, you again. I like a customer who comes back.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Rain keeps people home. It's just me and the shelves today.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: You came out in this snow? Here, warm your hands a minute.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: I added a page for you in the new ledger. Just notes. What you buy, what you grow. What you like.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Some mornings I read Father's last page again before I open up. Then I open up.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Tome says I hum behind the counter now. I'd deny it, but she's never wrong.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: I put aside the good dango for you. Don't tell Kota.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: It's nice, having someone to talk to who isn't buying soy sauce.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Your vegetables were the talk of the shrine path. I was proud, somehow.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Welcome! I'm Sayo. If we don't have it, you probably don't need it.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Seeds change with the season. Come and look when the weather turns.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Day off. I'm taking Grandma Tome some mochi. Shh, it's a surprise.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: I take an offering to the shrine every evening. For the shop, and for the village.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: The lanterns look pretty from here. Good evening.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Morning! Just sweeping the step. We open at nine.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Sakura mochi is in for spring. Only while the season lasts!

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: In summer I keep the shutters half down. The cool stays in.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Fall seeds are in. Carrots, eggplant, pumpkin. My favourite season.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Nothing grows in winter, so I sell warm drinks instead. Amazake?

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Thank you for coming by. Mind the step on the way out.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Is this really for me? Oh, how lovely!

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: You remembered what I like. Thank you, truly.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Oh, thank you! That's very thoughtful.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: A present? Thank you. I'll find a use for it.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Oh... um, thank you. It's the thought that counts.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: I... I'm sorry, I really can't take this one.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: One present a day is plenty. Save the rest for tomorrow!

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: A wind chime... listen to it ring!

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: I'll hang it in my window at home. Every time it rings, I'll think of today.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: A moon lantern! I'll light it on my windowsill at night.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: What a sweet little rabbit. It can mind the counter with me.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: A paper fan! The shop gets so stuffy in summer. Thank you!

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: A daruma... its eyes always seem to follow me around. Thank you, though.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: How nice. I'll find a spot for it somewhere.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Tamagoyaki, rolled so neatly!

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Mine always come apart in the pan. You'll have to show me how.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Milk pudding! You made a sweet just for me?

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: You cooked this? It looks almost too good to eat!

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Something you cooked? I'll have it for lunch behind the counter. Thank you!

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Home cooking! That's kind. I'll eat it this evening.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Oh... fish. I'm sorry, I've never managed to like it. Thank you anyway.
